result.text:
I’ll be stepping away from the CDL for the foreseeable future. 

As some of you know, I was very close to my casting partner Joe and his family. Maurisa was one of my best friends. We remained friends, after they divorced, and along the way it became more than that and we started dating. 

I understand how unconventional/taboo it is. It’s truly not something I ever foresaw happening. 

I hope that one day I’ll be back working on the CDL. If not, it was a hell of a ride, and I appreciate the love over the years. Please continue to show support to Joe, the CDL, and its talent!
